metadata.source: PSOC - Detects usage of AppLocker enumeration.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Detects usage of AppLocker enumeration
properties.description:
Detects enumeration of applocker
applocker protects from malicious powershell commands, attackers may enumerate this to determine what is not blocked.
properties.query:
// Detects enumeration of applocker
// applocker protects from malicious powershell commands, attackers may enumerate this to determine what is not blocked.
let cmd_any = dynamic(["get-childitem -path hklm:software\\policies\\microsoft\\windows\\srpv2 -recurse","reg query hkey_local_machine\\software\\policies\\microsoft\\windows\\srpv2\\exe\\","select -expandproperty rulecollections","(get-applockerpolicy -local).rulecollections","get-applockerpolicy -effective -xml"]);
_Im_ProcessCreate(commandline_has_any=cmd_any)
| extend
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUsername", "")),
    AccountDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUserDomain", "")),
    Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DvcHostname", "")),
    ProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessName", "")),
    ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessId", "")),
    CommandLine = tostring(column_ifexists("CommandLine", ""))
| where isnotempty(ProcessName)
